snippet.title: The Shafts of Damnation - Official Game Trailer
snippet.description:
The Shafts of Damnation is a Horror Game with a Story.

Rated Mature: Intense Violence, Blood and Gore, Strong Language.

 The DEMO game is available on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3481270/The_Shafts_of_Damnation/

Full game is Coming out 3. September.

Discord Community Server:
https://discord.gg/Pqg5nqMvrg

Developed by Solo Dev Ondřej Kraus
Published by Undying Vision
